4. Ārdrā, ‘moist,’ is the name of the brilliant star, Orionis. But the names by which it is styled, in the plural as Ārdrās in the śāṅkhāyana gṛhya sūtra and the Nakṣatrakalpa, and in the dual as Bāhū, in the taittirīya brāhmaṇa, point to a constellation of two or more stars, and it may be noted that the corresponding Chinese Sieou includes the seven brilliant stars composing the shoulders, the belt, and the knees of Orion.
